BiblicalUsage: Stammering speech is slow and broken, and Isaiah promises it will be healed. In Isaiah 32:4 the heart of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the promise is for more than speech: God opens the mouth that could not speak, and the stammerer speaks plainly at last.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
